question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 remove its closing reference so this issue can be closed against the already-shipped agent-tools fixes?
rationale: The repository evidence resolves the original report, but only a maintainer can correct or intentionally accept the live GitHub closing relationship on the unrelated fs-safe PR.

options.title: Remove closing syntax

options.title: Keep issue paired
options.body: Leave the closing syntax and keep this issue open until the fs-safe PR is merged or closed, despite its different scope.
